notes.title: Up Hike will be free to play!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Up Hike is officially becoming FREE TO PLAY on Steam! Starting next week, everyone will be able to dive into the action, explore breathtaking landscapes, and climb their way to the top – all at no cost.

Why Go Free to Play?
We want as many players as possible to experience the fun and adventure of Up Hike. By going free to play, we’re opening the doors to an even bigger community of players who can connect, compete, and explore together.
